description: Manages and provides details about various engagements, projects, or activities associated with partners.

endpoints.name: GetEngagementsByPartner
endpoints.description: Retrieves all engagements for a specific partner with complete details. Results are paginated and can be ordered. Use `pageIndex` and `pageSize` for pagination, and `orderBy` with `ascending` for sorting.

partnerId.description: Partner ID to filter engagements by

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: List engagements for specific partner organization
Show engagement records for a partner
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see all engagements associated with a specific partner.

endpoints.name: GetEngagementsByPartnerName
endpoints.description: Retrieves all engagements for a partner using AI-powered smart search by partner name. This endpoint uses semantic similarity search to find the best matching partner, supporting partial names, abbreviations, and synonyms. Results are paginated and can be ordered. Use `pageIndex` and `pageSize` for pagination, and `orderBy` with `ascending` for sorting.

partnerName.description: Partner name or partial name to search for (supports fuzzy matching, abbreviations, synonyms)

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: false for newest first)

example_uses: Show all engagements for partner named "UNICEF"
List engagements for "World Bank" organization (works with "WB", "World Bank", "bank")
Get engagement history for partner "Red Cross" (works with "ICRC", "Red Cross", "Cross")
Display engagements for "WHO" partner (works with "World Health", "WHO", "Health Organization")
Show engagement records using partial names like "UN" or "Development"
Find engagements by organization type like "Government" or "NGO"
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see all engagements for a partner using any variation of the partner name, abbreviation, or description. The AI search will find the best match even with incomplete or alternative names.
